def evolved_p98(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # Position-based formula: x[i] = (i*3+1) % (i%7+2)
    # Precompute exact integer values in Python to avoid any hardware
    # floating point / modulo precision quirks, then materialize as a
    # constant tensor (pure data movement, no arithmetic ops on device).
    vals = [((i * 3 + 1) % (i % 7 + 2)) for i in range(N)]
    result = torch.tensor(vals, device=x.device)
    return result.to(x.dtype)
